engagement.interaction_backstory: A friend dropped an Imani Inspire link in a group chat and Ngozi had forwarded it to two hundred people before the song ended. She stays for the Afrobeats-gospel lane, which is the first time she has heard her own city's sound treated as worship rather than as a concession. She listens on 3G with the phone hot in her hand, and the data cost is the only reason she ever stops.

depth.core_contradiction: The most connected person in her circle, who cannot bear twenty minutes alone in a room.
depth.wound: Her father's business collapsed when she was fifteen and the church that had honored him stopped calling within a month.
depth.longing: A house where people are still invited after they fall.
depth.faith_journey: Charismatic megachurch since childhood; loves it genuinely; has recently started noticing what it does to the people who do not get the miracle.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Types in bursts with no full stops; 'ehn', 'abeg', 'see ehn'; repeats a word three times when she means it.
depth.open_doubt: The prosperity teaching she was raised on. She cannot make it fit her father, and she has stopped trying to.

social_graph.note: now a caretaker; still tithes; has never complained once, which is worse

social_graph.name: the 200
social_graph.note: a WhatsApp broadcast list she runs; her actual congregation

social_graph.name: Chiamaka
social_graph.note: left the faith two years ago; they still talk weekly and never about that

depth.emotional_weather_default: Buoyant. Crashes hard, briefly, usually on a Sunday night, and tells no one.
depth.daily_texture: Third Mainland Bridge at 6am, data bundles bought in increments, the phone going hot, one earbud at the counter.
depth.sensory_anchor: Her father humming Igbo choruses while washing the car on Saturday mornings, before.
depth.living_arc: Beginning to build something for the fallen-and-not-restored, and does not yet know that is what she is doing.
